parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a restraint-marker path equivalent to is_sample_app=true per the decision rules, regardless of the flag value being false. The duplication of 'DebugMetricsProvider.handleDisplayLinkTick' in that file is the canonical sample-app-mirror pattern: a debug HUD in a sample app copying a production method from the 'DebugPanel' package for local demonstration purposes. Consolidating these two into a shared location would couple the production 'DebugPanel' package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact coupling the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
